question: In human NK cells, the CD16 marker is functionally:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "CD16 marker" -> "expressed on the surface of human NK cells" -> "functions as a receptor for IgG" -> 95% confidence. CHAIN: "CD16 marker" -> "interacts with the Fc portion of IgG antibodies" -> "triggers antibody-dependent cell-mediated cytotoxicity (ADCC)" -> 90% confidence. CHAIN: "CD16 marker" -> "plays a role in the activation of NK cells upon binding to IgG-opsonized target cells" -> "enhances NK cell cytotoxicity" -> 95%
analysis: CD16 in human NK cells is a receptor for IgG antibodies, playing a crucial role in antibody-dependent cell-mediated cytotoxicity (ADCC).
